key_insight: FARMS turns computational mathematics into reusable, AI-ready knowledge linking formal statements with source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees.
engineering_relevance: It provides a foundation for AI systems to select and apply numerical methods with explicit mathematical guarantees.
method: Prepare source material and encode reusable mathematical representations.
Review semantic fidelity to source context and algorithmic meaning.
Use Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises to connect selected statements to computational skills.
evidence_signal: The pipeline accepted 157 of 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical PDEs, with mean estimated costs of US$0.85–2.29 per target across sources; demonstrations included a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression.
watch_item: Lean-checked guarantees apply to selected statements under explicit premises, not automatically to entire numerical implementations.
paper_title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
